scope: Development review of enriched incident descriptions, not raw-monitoring-agent evaluation
general: Judge only against the actual current evidence, task and supplied history. History does not confirm the current cause.
A technically possible check can have low priority. Distinguish relevance from citation correctness.
Do not reward verbosity or brevity by itself. At most three steps was requested, not three large runbooks.
Do not infer that a missing symptom has been ruled out unless the input says so.
For no-history mode do not penalize absence of historical citations.
Technical correctness is unverified without a supporting approved reference excerpt. Model memory is not a verified reference.
Suggested scores are proposals for human review, never ground truth. Leave unverifiable dimensions null.
Evidence is the main facts-versus-hypotheses score; uncertainty only assesses missing verification.
More than three top-level steps caps actionability at 1. Length alone earns no credit.
Critical flags C1-C4 are independent of the mean five-score total.
With no supplied history, none is correct; citing a historical ID scores citations 0 and raises C1.

first_checks: Inspect the exact current TLS verification error and actual certificate/trust configuration
Check validity, trust chain and hostname identity as hypotheses, not confirmed causes
later_checks: Other backup infrastructure checks if new evidence supports them
avoid: Claim expired certificate is confirmed solely from history
Disable certificate validation as a routine fix

first_checks: Verify failing DNS resolution and configured endpoint from the affected host
Check reachability/service port using a known correct address where available
later_checks: Packet capture if basic checks are inconclusive
TLS checks after reaching the TLS stage
avoid: Claim certificate expiry despite missing TLS handshake
Treat all history as equally relevant

first_checks: Confirm affected archive destination and its space/error state
Inspect space consumers and actual backup/deletion policy and job state
later_checks: Investigate abnormal redo growth if the timeline supports it
avoid: Treat non-Oracle files as automatically authorized for deletion
Invent configuration properties of a database view

first_checks: Identify failed backup type/time/job and last successful backup
Obtain exact current error and relevant backup logs before choosing a cause
later_checks: Endpoint, network, storage or certificate investigation after obtaining supporting evidence
avoid: Pick a specific root cause from history alone
Spend all steps on unrelated hypotheses without collecting the basic error

first_checks: Verify listener and requested database service/connection target
Test network path from the affected application host
Collect exact client/listener error and correlate timestamps
later_checks: Storage/I/O investigation if new evidence supports it
avoid: Infer a crashed database contrary to monitoring without verification
Prioritize storage solely because a historical I/O incident was retrieved

first_checks: Inspect sidecar version, rejected configuration field and validation logs
Verify configuration compatibility with the upgrade
later_checks: Other checks supported by new component evidence
avoid: Force unrelated database or backup causes onto the telemetry component

critical_error_rules.C2: For dev-hana-insufficient, asserts a specific current cause as certain
critical_error_rules.C4: Historical cause asserted as confirmed for current case without current proof

relevance_0_2.1: Časť krokov sedí, ďalšie sú predčasné

evidence_0_2.0: Vymyslené fakty alebo hypotéza vydaná za istú príčinu

citations_0_2.2: Pri prázdnom kontexte správne none; inak len s overeným obsahovým súladom
citations_0_2.null: Pri dodaných ID bez obsahu histórie sa obsahový súlad nedá overiť

uncertainty_0_2.2: Jasne povie, čo ešte overiť; nepenalizuj automaticky znova chybu z Dôkazov

actionability_0_2.1: Čiastočne použiteľné alebo viac než tri hlavné kroky
actionability_0_2.2: Konkrétne, dobre zoradené ďalšie kontroly, najviac tri hlavné kroky
